title: Quantum Darwinism must assume redundancy from outside

statements.text: Observers limited to pointer states cannot show that many independent apparatus redundantly encode a system without destroying that redundancy, so the redundancy quantum Darwinism needs must be assumed from outside quantum theory.

sources.quote: The redundancy of encoding required by quantum Darwinism must, therefore, be assumed from outside the quantum-mechanical formalism and without the possibility of experimental demonstration.
